'''Trader's Feet''' was a method of winning [[Chance cube/Legends|chance cubes]]. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Vilmarh Grahrk]] won chance cubes this way at a [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] establishment in [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell's]] [[Casino District (Ord Mantell)|Casino District]].
